class.name: CgameBitWriter
class.brief_description: Packs integers, varints and quantized values into a bit stream.
class.description: [CgameBitWriter] appends values to a byte buffer with bit granularity. Bits are written least-significant first, so values are not byte aligned unless [method align_to_byte] is called. The layout is identical to the [code]BitWriter[/code] used by the GDScript net schema. Quantized helpers map floats to fixed-point integers over a known range. The maximum error of [method write_float] is half a quantum: [code](max - min) / (2^bits - 1) / 2[/code]. [codeblock] var w := CgameBitWriter.new() w.write_bits(5, 3) w.write_float(12.5, -100.0, 100.0, 16) w.write_quaternion(Quaternion(Vector3.UP, 1.0)) var packet: PackedByteArray = w.get_bytes() [/codeblock] Read the data back with [CgameBitReader].

method.name: align_to_byte
method.description: Skips the remaining bits of the current byte so the next write starts on a byte boundary.

method.name: get_bit_count
method.description: Returns the number of bits written so far.

method.name: get_byte_count
method.description: Returns the number of bytes occupied, rounding partial bytes up.

method.name: get_bytes
method.description: Returns a copy of the written bytes. Unused bits of the last byte are zero.

method.name: write_angle
method.description: Writes an angle wrapped into [code][0, TAU)[/code] using [param bits] bits (1 to 32) with no duplicate endpoint.

method.name: write_bits
method.description: Writes the lowest [param bits] bits (0 to 64) of [param value]. Higher bits are discarded.

method.name: write_bytes
method.description: Writes every byte of [param bytes] as eight bits, without a length prefix.

method.name: write_float
method.description: Writes [param value] clamped to the range and quantized to [param bits] bits (1 to 32).

method.name: write_float32
method.description: Writes the raw 32-bit IEEE 754 representation of [param value].

method.name: write_quaternion
method.description: Writes [param value] using the "smallest three" encoding: two bits identify the largest component, and the other three are quantized to [param bits_per_component] bits each in the range [code]±1/√2[/code]. The quaternion is normalized first; a zero quaternion becomes the identity.

method.name: write_signed_varint
method.description: Writes a zigzag-encoded variable-length integer (groups of seven bits plus a continuation bit). Small magnitudes of either sign use few bytes.

method.name: write_string
method.description: Writes an 8-bit byte length followed by the UTF-8 bytes. Longer strings are truncated to 255 bytes.

method.name: write_varint
method.description: Writes [param value] as an unsigned variable-length integer (LEB128 groups of seven bits). Negative values use ten groups.

method.name: write_vector3
method.description: Writes each axis as in [method write_float] with the same range and [param bits_per_axis] bits.
